rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for rule by the people or democracy as a political system.

example.english: Democracy is a system where the people are in charge.
example.traditional: 民主就係人民當家作主嘅制度。
example.jyutping: man4 zyu2 zau6 hai6 jan4 man4 dong1 gaa1 zok3 zyu2 ge3 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to a country or state governed democratically.

example.english: A democracy usually allows people to hold free elections.
example.traditional: 民主國家通常容許人民自由選舉。
example.jyutping: man4 zyu2 gwok3 gaa1 tung1 soeng4 jung4 heoi2 jan4 man4 zi6 jau4 syun2 geoi2
